title: Finite-strain Bauschinger cycle in Lagrangian logarithmic strain
source: Miehe, Apel and Lambrecht, CMAME 191:5383–5425 (2002), doi:10.1016/S0045-7825(02)00438-3, logarithmic-strain plasticity with Prager hardening (W. Prager, The theory of plasticity: a survey of recent achievements, Proc. Inst. Mech. Eng. 169:41–57, 1955). Uniaxial relations: E_t = E H/(E+H), tau_a = sigma_y + E_t (e_a - sigma_y/E), tau_r = tau_a - 2 sigma_y - E_t (e_a - 2 sigma_y/E), J_r = exp(tau_r/(3K)), sigma_r = tau_r/J_r, ep = (E e_a - sigma_y)/(E+H) + (E e_a - 2 sigma_y)/(E+H)

quantities.quantity: Cauchy axial stress after returning from axial logarithmic strain 0.2 to zero displacement
quantities.reason: Homogeneous uniaxial stress with free lateral contraction; the Kirchhoff residual must be converted to Cauchy stress with the residual elastic volume
